summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, attaching the final minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on May 12, 2026. The filing is a routine disclosure of corporate governance matters, including shareholder voting results and other ordinary business. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event is referenced. The filing is purely procedural under the Oslo Børs and Norwegian Securities Trading Act, with no deal terms, strategic review, or capital return initiative announced.
